name: Aristan's Hunch
label: Quest
description: Aristan's Hunch: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've got it! Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion? Our guards wouldn't neglect their duties so easily.
That is, unless their thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.
There is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to Morgan Pestle, and tell him my suspicions. I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Something I can help you with?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I understand Aristan's concerns, but I really think he's overreacting. Let young men and women do what they will. I think Aristan has forgotten what it means to be young and in love.
But it would be better not to tell him that. We'll humor him.
